$comment: Real deployment. Chain is the source of truth; this file is the record.

nftMetadata.$comment: The registry itself is the ERC-721 (Durin L2Registry); tokenId is the name's node in decimal. setBaseURI (2026-10-02, signed by the registry owner) points tokenURI at the web app's metadata route, which reads names(node) straight from the chain and serves image = /name/<label>/card.png. Before this, tokenURI returned an on-chain JSON with the name only and no image.

mainnetSetup.$comment: Root name connected 2026-09-30. Two transactions signed by the name owner (0x022Ce19a…85b7): the resolver learns where the data lives, then the root points at the resolver — that order, so the root itself never goes unresolvable halfway. Verified afterwards with scripts/l1-resolver.mjs (8/8) and a real ENS lookup of five names.
mainnetSetup.setL2RegistryNote: Signed in the same sitting; the transaction hash was not captured. On chain state is the record: scripts/l1-resolver.mjs reads l2Registry(musepass.eth) back from the resolver and asserts it equals the registry above.
